method: Connected dark-or-warm cavity/tongue pixels for open poses, unchanged dark ink for rest; convex envelope includes enclosed bright teeth. Candidate only, not accepted mask.
limits: Warm segmentation can include lip shadow and still omit pale rim; requires painted-boundary review.
Convex envelope can include teeth but can overfill lip curvature.
Closed smile bounding-box height is curved ink, not jaw opening.
No pixel-aligned rig, deformation, motion, lip sync or human mouth-attachment acceptance.
